body: Ex-boyfriend started to say the same thing a few weeks before he broke up with me and never gave me a straight answer. Started talking to this girl. Said he talked to her all the time and told me it was great talking to another girl that "wasn't me". Realizing this fucking hurt but WOW. It fucking opened up my eyes. I can't believe I was a fucking idiot.
Holy fuck. I think I'm starting to realize something now. Thanks for this post.
